exposure: Chinese Expert Consensus on the Prevention and Treatment of VTE during Pregnancy and Puerperium
cohort: The study included 560 postpartum women, comprising 140 cases with VTE and 420 cases without VTE (controls).
finding: The study found that postpartum hemorrhage, anti-phospholipid antibody positivity, and D-dimer levels were closely associated with thrombosis, and both the QLD guideline and Chinese Consensus showed suboptimal performance in estimating postpartum VTE risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as the most frequent risk factor triggering VTE.
